articles.title: Trump’s Call to FIFA Sparks Outrage: Did Politics Sway a World Cup Ban?
articles.summary: President Trump confirmed he asked FIFA to review U.S. striker Folarin Balogun’s red-card suspension. FIFA then suspended the one-match ban for 12 months, letting Balogun play against Belgium. Critics, including UEFA and Belgium, say the decision undermines soccer’s integrity.

articles.title: Royal Rift on Full Display: Harry’s Palace Stay Sparks War of Words
articles.summary: Prince Harry’s team announced he would stay at Buckingham Palace during his UK visit, but the Palace flatly denied it. The contradictory accounts reveal deep distrust between the Sussex camp and the monarchy. A court ruling and security fears add to the tension, complicating a possible meeting with King Charles.
